steps.subject: {{first_name}}, how many calls did {{company_name}} miss last week?
steps.body:
Hi {{first_name}},

Serious question — do you know how many inbound calls {{company_name}} missed last week? (After hours, during lunch, when the phones were slammed?)

For most {{industry}} businesses, it's 30-40% of all calls. And 78% of customers go with whoever answers first.

We built an AI phone agent that answers every single call in under 2 seconds — 24/7. It qualifies the caller, answers their questions, and books appointments directly on your calendar.

Sounds futuristic, but it's live and working today. Costs less than a part-time receptionist.

Worth a 15-min demo?

{{sender_name}}
Realside AI

steps.subject: last one from me

personalization_variables.ai_personalization_prompt: Research if the prospect's business has: a phone number prominently on their website, reviews mentioning wait times or missed calls, job postings for receptionists, or uses an answering service. Use one finding as the personalized first line.
